sources.title: China's synthetic natural gas revolution
sources.source_type: Technical commentary using existing life-cycle and cost estimates
sources.reading_scope: All target text, 15 references, Table1 and Figures1–2 read; all3 physical pages visually inspected. Unrelated forest-carbon commentary beginning bottom ofp854 excluded.
sources.use: A contemporaneous technical warning about divergent air-quality and greenhouse consequences of coal-derived gas.
sources.limits: Approved/planned capacity not realized production; life-cycle/projected effects not national measured outcomes. Figure1 gas comparison is shale gas. Cost estimates use different assumptions and pre-operation China estimates. Not participant negotiation evidence.
sources.counting: Complete technical context listed separately from social-science/legal scholarly works, not classified as partial.

boundary: Public texts establish positions and requirements; no private Chinese mandate or actual policy-performance inference.
